details: Bitcoin's price is settling lower, influenced by continued negative pressure from trading below the EMA50, which acts as dynamic resistance. The crypto market capitalization saw a modest 0.9% decline over 24 hours, with Bitcoin slipping around 1%. This comes as the U.S. Treasury's expanded $6 billion bond buyback on September 10th did not trigger a rally as a similar move did previously. Analysts suggest this indicates a period of market consolidation rather than a sharp reversal, with Bitcoin remaining stuck in a resistance zone between $80,000 and $82,000. Sell-side risk has decreased to a one-month low as long-term holders reduced profit-taking.
title: Bitcoin Faces Negative Pressure Amid Treasury Bond Buybacks and Price Consolidation

details: Ethereum Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a $24.29 million net outflow on September 8, following two weeks of record-breaking inflows, raising questions about institutional appetite. Despite this, Ethereum's price is maintaining recovery chances, finding support at EMA50 and attempting to break the $2,500 resistance. In a significant structural move, Consensys, the company behind MetaMask, announced it will split into two independent entities by the end of 2026: MetaMask will focus on consumer products, while a new Consensys entity will handle Ethereum protocol development and institutional blockchain infrastructure. Additionally, Ethereum's protocol team has set December 2029 as the deadline for achieving full quantum resistance.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Outflows, While Consensys Splits Businesses for Future Growth

details: XRP continues to consolidate around $1.42 following its strong August breakout, comfortably trading above major moving averages. Upcoming events include a Senate cloture vote on the CLARITY Act and a Federal Reserve policy meeting, both potentially impacting XRP's price. The XRP Ledger is also set for an upgrade on September 11th, with a "fixCleanup3_3_0" bundle going live, carrying 11 fixes across vaults, lending, and trading pools. Institutional inflows for XRP exchange-traded products have seen a brief deceleration, reflecting temporary demand fatigue and macroeconomic headwinds.
title: XRP Consolidates Ahead of Key Senate Vote and Ledger Upgrade

details: Ethereum Classic (ETC) experienced a significant drop of roughly 10-12% over the past day, driven by sharp reversal after a short-term pump, concentrated whale selling, and a mildly risk-off macro backdrop. The decline is not attributed to a single negative headline specific to ETC but rather profit-taking after recent outperformance. Total crypto market cap slipped about 1.42%, while spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs also saw net outflows, reflecting a reduction in risk appetite.
title: Ethereum Classic Drops 12% Amid Whale Selling and Risk-Off Sentiment

details: The Arab Global Crypto Exchange (AGCX), a CMA-licensed Virtual Assets platform, officially launched on September 10, 2026. The exchange aims to simplify access to digital assets for UAE residents and eligible users by supporting direct AED bank transfers and offering zero platform fees on crypto deposits and withdrawals. Founded by veteran capital markets executive Satish Gogia, AGCX is designed to address the challenges of moving between AED and digital assets in the region.
title: Arab Global Crypto Exchange Launches with AED Support and Zero Fees
